title: Seam regression set v1 (2026-09-08)
description: Hard seam pairs picked from measured properties of 144 local tracks (scripts/diag/regression_scan.py) plus the seams that failed in real sets, then four plain controls. Each pair is rendered in full by the current mixer; only the seam region is placed in the file. Rebuild: python -m scripts.regression_set (writes data/external/regression_set/, never the listen folder). Verdicts and approved numbers go into each pair's `approved` block: {verdict, shift_ms, gain_db, bars, notes}.

pairs.edge_case: syncopated bass under a straight kick; 8-bar breakdown right after B's cue-in
pairs.reason: Amelie Lens → Mosaic, techno_build seam 1: the kick-band correlation locked onto Mosaic's off-beat bass and shifted an aligned pair +121 ms (a 16th). Mosaic's first 8 body bars are a breakdown (the loudness anchor case). Anas heard the beats off near 4:20 (2026-09-08).

pairs.edge_case: off-beat hats; kick and other layers half a beat apart

A.name: Sin Sin – Break Down (Tom Laws Remix)

pairs.reason: Sin Sin → Nova, ear-test techno pair 2: kick +103 ms vs bass/mids/hats −116 ms. Anas preferred the kick reading; the grid method sounded worse. At 16 bars the reading flips to −198 ms.

pairs.edge_case: kick reading wrong, consensus of the other layers right (quarter-beat disagreement)
pairs.reason: Wigbert → Joyhauser, techno_high seam at 4:14: kick +75 ms (corr 0.12) vs others +194 ms. A/B clips: Anas chose the consensus. Joyhauser downbeat confidence 0.37. A cue-out pinned at bar 128 (drop) so the 40-bar melt fits before the outro.

pairs.edge_case: cue-out lands in A's breakdown: overlap opens 7 dB under A
pairs.reason: Farrago → Heil, ear-test techno pair 1: the overlap opened 7 dB under A's last bar; the gain ride must lift +7 in. Heil downbeat confidence 0.38, 104 breakdown bars. 3 % stretch each way (133 → 130).

pairs.edge_case: one-bar drop-outs in A's last bars pull the level anchor down
pairs.reason: Materium → Vale: A's last bars read −22/−42/−25/−17 dB; a plain median anchored 4–6 dB under what the ear held. Materium downbeat confidence 0.34, −13.5 LUFS vs Vale −11.

pairs.edge_case: very quiet master into the most syncopated, least confident track; drop-aligned entry

A.name: Nduduzo Makhathini & Fka Mash – ft. Anna Widauer - Re-amathambo

B.name: Safar (FR) – ft. Dikla Hackmon - Thousand And Two Nights (Paso Doble Remix)

pairs.reason: Nduduzo −21.4 LUFS (13 dB under the genre) → Safar: off-beat low end 0.87, off-8th hats 0.72, downbeat confidence 0.23 (lowest of 144). B pinned so the overlap runs over its breakdown and lands on the drop at bar 120.

pairs.edge_case: weak kick on both sides: A cues out in a kick-less break, B enters with a kick-less intro
pairs.reason: Il Monte (kick share 0.12, lowest in the genre; 0.03 in the break at bar 64) → Coco (intro kick share 0.09). Nothing periodic in the kick band to align on.

pairs.edge_case: drum and bass: weak kick, loudest master, low downbeat confidence
pairs.reason: Trakker (−3.8 LUFS, kick share 0.17, confidence 0.48, half-time feel kpb 2.5) → Mistrust (kick share 0.13). Ear-test pair 4 needed +4.7/+3.8 dB gains.

pairs.edge_case: drum and bass: doubled/ghost kicks, breakbeat pattern

A.name: Alix Perez – ft. Foreign Beggars - The Cut Deepens

pairs.reason: Alix Perez (ghost 4.6, the most extra kick-band hits per beat) → Teddy Killerz (−4.6 LUFS). Kick is not one per beat, so any one-hit-per-beat method is tested here. A cue-out pinned at bar 48; the track is only 66 bars long. B cue-in pinned at bar 64 (drop) so 16 bars fit before its minimum body.

pairs.edge_case: large stretch (12 % tempo gap, 6 % each way) into a breakdown-heavy track
pairs.reason: Katoff 123.0 → Peetu S 138.0, both stretched ~6 % to 130.5 (past the 4 % warning). Peetu S has 132 breakdown bars; B pinned at bar 40 so a break follows 16 bars after the cue-in. A cue-out pinned at bar 96 (drop) so 32 bars fit.

pairs.edge_case: off-8th hats on both records, quiet vs loud master, low confidence

A.name: PARAFRAME – ft. Ryan Masson - Son Of Earth

pairs.reason: PARAFRAME (hats off the 8ths 0.60, kick share 0.19, confidence 0.47, −12.1 LUFS) → Koyah (hats 0.56, off-beat low end 0.75, −7.8 LUFS). Hats dominate both sides of the correlation. A cue-out pinned at bar 136 (drop) so 32 bars fit.

Andruss – Active (confidence 0.96, hats 0.05) → Binga (0.94), 0.8 % apart. Both cue bars chosen by measurement: level within 1.5 dB over the block before and three blocks after the seam, drop/groove with a present kick. Replaced RSquared, whose seam sat on its own drop (+7.5 dB content step).
KlangKuenstler (confidence 0.92, hats 0.18) → Capricorn 20Hz (0.75), 0.7 % apart. A cue-out pinned at bar 88 (steady -8 dB drop); the mixer's choice (128) was a -14 dB buildup.

Krissky (confidence 0.99, hats 0.11) → Gorje Hewek Children (0.99, hats 0.15), 1.6 % apart. Cue bars pinned by measurement (A 152, B 64): steady level, drop/groove, kick present; the mixer's own choice cued A out in its outro with B's drop landing right after the overlap.

B.name: Factor B – ft. Theia - Everywhere To Me

pairs.reason: Craig Forsyth (confidence 0.91) → Factor B (0.91), same tempo.
